questions.q: What is the media planner's first step when designing a campaign?
options: Choosing the bid strategy based on the approved budget
Understanding the real business goal the client wants to achieve
Defining the placements where the creative will look best
Configuring the conversion event inside Events Manager
questions.explanation: Everything starts from the business goal: without knowing what the business wants, the bid, placements and events are configured blindly.

questions.q: At which level of the hierarchy is the campaign objective chosen?
options: At the account level, once for all campaigns
At the ad set level, next to the performance goal
At the campaign level, and it stays fixed for that campaign
At the ad level, because it depends on the final creative
questions.explanation: The objective is chosen when creating the campaign and can't be changed later. Location, event and performance goal live at the ad set level; the ad is creative only.

questions.q: Sales website with the Purchase event requires as data source:
options: Only the Pixel, which records everything from the browser
Pixel + Conversions API (CAPI) sending events together
A customer list updated every week as the signal
The Facebook SDK connected to the business website
questions.explanation: The standard is Pixel + CAPI together: CAPI recovers the signal the browser loses to blockers and iOS. The SDK is for apps, not web.

options: They are two names for the same ad set configuration
The event is configured at the campaign level and the goal at the ad level
The event only applies to Sales; the goal only to Awareness
The event defines which action counts; the goal defines how delivery optimizes
questions.explanation: Event = WHICH action counts as success (e.g. Purchase). Performance goal = HOW Meta optimizes delivery (e.g. maximize value). Both live in the ad set.

questions.q: A B2B company wants demos booked without taking the prospect out of the feed. Best combination?
options: Sales + Website with a Schedule event on the external page
Leads + Instant form inside Meta
Awareness + estimated ad recall lift as the metric
Traffic + link clicks to the website calendar
questions.explanation: 'Without leaving the feed' points to Instant form: the form is filled inside Meta with minimal friction. Website or link clicks push the prospect out.

questions.q: A finance app wants installs and its measurement runs on AppsFlyer. Correct combination?
options: App Promotion measured with the website Pixel
Sales website with the Purchase event and value tracking
App Promotion with the Facebook SDK or the MMP as the source
Leads with an Instant form and a customer list
questions.explanation: In-app events are measured with the Facebook SDK or an authorized MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust). The Pixel is web-only and never measures installs.

questions.q: An ecommerce with tickets from $200 to $9,000 MXN has a revenue goal, not an order goal. Performance goal?
options: Maximize number of conversions to gather more orders
Maximize link clicks to fill the funnel with visits
Maximize reach so more people see the store
Maximize value of conversions with value tracking active
questions.explanation: Highly variable tickets + revenue goal = optimize for VALUE, not volume. Requires value tracking on the Pixel to report amounts.

questions.q: You propose Sales website, but in Events Manager the Purchase event isn't arriving. What do you do first?
options: Fix the signal (Pixel/CAPI reporting Purchase) before launching
Launch anyway: the campaign gathers signal while it runs
Switch the objective to Awareness in the meantime
Optimize to link clicks and migrate to Purchase later
questions.explanation: Signal first, then objective: without Purchase arriving at the dataset, the campaign has nothing to optimize toward. Launching without signal burns budget.

questions.q: Where are conversion location, conversion event and performance goal configured?
options: At the campaign level, next to the campaign objective
At the ad level, because they depend on the final creative
At the ad set level, all three together
In Events Manager, inside the Pixel dataset
questions.explanation: The three knobs live in the ad set. In Events Manager you only verify the signal arrives; the campaign level holds the objective.

questions.q: A brand-new business with no signal installed wants leads NOW. What does the planner propose?
options: Sales website right away, while the team installs the Pixel
Waiting a few weeks for CAPI to mature and launching Sales website later
Leads + Instant form: the data stays inside Meta without requiring a Pixel
App Promotion to avoid depending on the website
questions.explanation: Instant form doesn't require a Pixel: data is captured inside Meta. It's the way to start leads while the web signal gets installed.
